title: Moderated usability research
description: Research planning and observed evidence for testing an interface with representative participants.

sources.title: GOV.UK Service Manual, Using moderated usability testing
GOV.UK Service Manual, Plan a round of user research

rules.instruction: Select participants whose experience relates to the research question. Prepare realistic tasks without leading them to the interface controls they should find.
rules.verification: Pilot the guide and check that instructions, recruitment criteria, consent and recording settings were reviewed by the research owner.

rules.instruction: Record what participants did, distinguish observations from interpretation and describe the consequence of each issue for the user task.
rules.verification: Verify priority findings against session notes. Assign a follow-up owner and a way to check whether the proposed change helps.
